selection.identity: Original direct-room candidate pools and original Q/QT algorithms; fixed old selections rescored and current histories reselected on the same candidates are separate
selection.source_of_policy_parameters: frozen native_teams/study.py from the v2 closeout
selection.quality_history: mean leave-one-person-out relative Q on available images outside the entire target building; minimum 8 images and 3 buildings
selection.time_history: mean log-time relative to peers in the same image, condition, target, origin and logging semantics; minimum 8 images and 3 buildings
selection.fast_constraint: greedy labor reduction subject to historical team-mean relative Q no more than 2 points below the outside_Q team; this is not a bound on actual target quality loss
selection.main_weighting: source contexts and repeated random choices within target image, then images within building, then equal buildings
selection.old_class_enforcement_policy: half_Q_structure is not relabeled or presented as a newly selected class policy

stopping.identity: Keep original group panels, exact common people, 256 existing orders where present, original smaller-pool exhaustive orders and all original source budgets
stopping.source_choice: earliest k at least 3 within 2 points of the maximum already-observed complete source-mean curve
stopping.target_topup: continue only until complete output geometry, without inspecting target Q
stopping.maximum_history: N minus 1 source views in the originally supported declared group
stopping.original_two_person_status: deferred, never assigned Q=0 or newly evaluated here
stopping.history_cost: full original common pool on every source view once, reused across all order replays; comparison to all views using fixed 7 with identical geometry-only topup
stopping.lawful_cost_support: all team members have new-origin reported activity with complete same-semantics records across every source and target
stopping.reference_creation_cost: unrecorded, excluded from observed annotation labor rather than filled with zero

missing_policy: Q, D10, geometry and lawful labor keep separate valid denominators; failed, unscorable and other missing states are separately retained
selection_reason: restore the original v2 uses chain under current qualification/reference/history, independent of current target gain
classification_adoption: not addressed or finalized by these utility analyses
